item.summary: Effective dissemination of official statistics requires that users can readily find the data they need, access them in usable formats and reuse them for analysis. The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) developed eSankhyiki as a one-stop window for official statistics. The portal enables users to search datasets, explore indicators through interactive visualisations,…
item.title: MoSPI launches State Dashboard on eSankhyiki to improve access to State-level statistics
